summary: Backend-only security fix verification for iteration_7. Verified all 3 fixes: (1) GET /api/research/{id}, all 5 /export/* endpoints, and /research/stream/{id} now require auth (401) and enforce ownership (403 for non-owner non-admin). (2) POST /api/auth/logout works without auth. (3) Malformed JWT sub returns 401 instead of 500. All 25 new security tests pass; 17 regression auth-flow tests still pass (42/42 total).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1396 lines - consider splitting into routers (research, exports, admin) for maintainability.
Ownership check logic (session.user_id vs current_user.id + admin bypass) is duplicated between get_research_session, stream_research, and _get_session_for_user. Consolidate to a single helper.
In stream_research, session variable is shadowed inside event_generator - safe here but easy to confuse. Rename outer var (used only for ownership) to _ownership_check.
seed_data_creation: Test users are created with TEST_sec_<uuid> emails; a real research session is started via /research/start (fast_mode) per module for ownership tests. No manual cleanup - test data uses unique emails so runs don't collide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_research_auth_security.py is idempotent (unique test emails per run). Loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or /app/frontend/.env fallback. All 5 export formats + stream + get session are covered for auth (401) and ownership (403). Admin bypass verified. Malformed JWT sub verified by signing a bogus payload with real JWT_SECRET from /app/backend/.env.
rca of the issue: N/A - fixes verified working end-to-end. Iteration_6 findings addressed correctly.
